steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Are all the preparations in place?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Sir Gnosis!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: May I ask you a question...?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Now this is rare. This might be the first time you've asked me anything.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: If I may be so bold.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I'm afraid that the Browntails might get caught up in the investigation that follows, if we go through with our plan.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I... I'm just worried that, now that you and the Browntails have formed an alliance, wouldn't it be detrimental to your plan if anything should happen to the Browntails?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I've considered that, but it doesn't matter. What becomes of the Browntails isn't important. This is a rare opportunity, and I do not want it to go to waste.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: At the same time, I hope you'll know to save your own skin.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Should worst come to pass, you needn't think about the Browntails. I know Enciodes. If your testimony is useful to him, he won't harm you. At least for the time being.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: And when the time comes, I will send men to ensure your safety.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Sir Gnosis! I...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If you are having any second thoughts, we can bring others to execute this plan in your stead.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: No...! Please, let me do it!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Whatever your orders, Sir Gnosis...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Your wish is my command.

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: We've taken care of all the beasts now!

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Some of the young'uns got a few scratches here and there. Nothing major at all... It's all thanks to you, Great Saintess!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I haven't done anything. Rather, all of you have admirably demonstrated your courage in battle. I am sure Kjeragandr is proud of all of you, Her soldiers.

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Y-You flatter us!

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Great Saintess!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Hm? You're... the one from earlier...

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Right, it's me. Thank you for saving my life just now!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Great Saintess! That was far too risky!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Nonetheless, I have to thank you for saving this runt!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: We are all children of Kjeragandr, and it's only natural for me to save one of my own.

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Great Saintess...!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That was truly a fine shot. I didn't know you were such a capable archer...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The Saintess must be able to protect the people of the Snow Realm. This is hardly worth mentioning.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You're too humble! With your shot just now, your marksmanship most definitely rivals even that of Kjerag's finest archers!

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: Great Saintess! Sir Arctosz, Madame Ratatos!

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: T-This is bad!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What are you babbling about? How is any of this bad?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You're one of the Silverashes? What's the matter? Don't tell me you were ambushed by beasts and Enciodes is looking for our help.

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: N-No, not beasts!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Then what is it? Out with it!

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: Y-Yes! Sir Enciodes was ambushed by an assassin!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What did you just say...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enciodes was ambushed? Somebody's so bold to make a move on him during the Holy Hunt?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Half of you, stay here to protect the Saintess. Stay alert.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The rest of you, come with me!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Wait, Arctosz, are you out of your mind?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What are you doing? Are you going to his aid? Before we even mention whether Enciodes really needs it or not, considering the circumstances... Have you really thought it through?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: There's nothing to think through, Ratatos.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I know what you are thinking, but it doesn't matter to me one bit whether Enciodes is really turning over a new leaf or is just putting on a show. I, Arctosz, won't permit anyone to make trouble during the Holy Hunt!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: —Generation after generation, my family has sworn to defend Kjerag, and that includes the integrity of the Holy Hunt!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Can't keep your cool, can you... Whatever, let's see where this kindness of yours will get us.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Enciodes...

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: Sir Enciodes! You're bleeding... Are you hurt?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm fine. No need to panic.

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: But you're injured!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's nothing major.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Fine stealth techniques. You caught me unaware... though I suppose it was careless of me to assume no one would make trouble during the Holy Hunt.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What's the matter? Not going to show yourself?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you had the courage to do this on such an occasion, surely you knew what a great disrespect it was to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Come now. Did you not consider this?
You can stop taunting me...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: If I'm brave enough to do this, of course I've considered the consequences.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Enciodes, if I don't make it out of these hunting grounds today, you're coming down with me!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Looks like you are truly determined.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: That goes without saying!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Enciodes, you act like a devout follower, but you don't have even the tiniest bit of veneration for Kjeragandr. All of us can see the damage you've brought to Kjerag!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's not often that someone says as much to me outright. There aren't that many in Kjerag who bear such a great grudge against me these days, after all.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: For you to criticize me like that, I must have done something to harm your profits... or perhaps you are a truly devout, even radical follower...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now which is it?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Do you think I'd just tell you?

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: Sir Enciodes, watch out!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Regrettable.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You had these berserk beasts prepared in advance, didn't you? I don't have many guards accompanying me during the Holy Hunt, and it's indeed a good chance to strike while they are preoccupied.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And yet... it looks like you've wasted your one chance.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Are you mocking me?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: You're hurt. It doesn't matter how lightly you make out your injuries, you can't fool me!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Your movement is starting to get sluggish, isn't it? I just have to land one more hit and...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Despite the circumstances?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now that we're facing off in the open, how confident are you in landing a fatal shot?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Tsk...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Let's find out, shall we?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Dammit... You can block arrows with that cane?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Are you screwing with me?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Please don't get the wrong idea. It is not my intention to look down on you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You came well-prepared, and you have an excellent plan. However, all plans must face be put into motion, and they rarely survive contact with the enemy.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: My hope is that everything can be solved by diplomacy, but one of my companions possesses exactly that level of violence. Thanks to her, I understand violent people well.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: What are you talking about?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Still not showing your true face? Or am I mistaken?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's a little hard to slice through an arrow after all.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: You—!

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: But that's just part of the job, Mr. Enciodes.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: So, will you two keep the fight up?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is not for me to decide.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Giving up is the best course of action here. At the very least, no lives will be lost.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: You can drop the kind act. It disgusts me.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: You want to get information from me, don't you? You want to know who it is that wants your life.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I've considered that, but it doesn't matter. What becomes of the Browntails isn't important. This is a rare opportunity, and I do not want it to go to waste.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: At the same time, I hope you'll know to save your own skin.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Should worst come to pass, you needn't think about the Browntails. I know Enciodes. If your testimony is useful to him, he won't harm you. At least for the time being.
Monch, Monch!
Where'd you go! Come help take a look at my plan. This one will show Ratatos, for sure!
Oh, Monch, I knew you had my back. Everyone else's always calling me dumb. Hah, they think I don't know...
Monch, tell me. Do you think I make something of the Browntails? I can, right? Right...? Yep! I knew you wouldn't lie to me!
Monch...!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: —I won't let you!
Her movement is swift as always, as though she is leaping across a river, and as though she is leaping off a tree.
In an instant, her black figure springs off the ground, before falling and disappearing below the cliffs.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: She leapt off...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: An unexpected choice.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You didn't stop her.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: That's not part of my mission.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: You don't seem so surprised either.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There aren't many who can properly set up the pieces on the hunting grounds. If we search for evidence, we're bound to find some.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Of course, having a witness would've saved us some trouble... Though whether the witness is alive or dead doesn't actually matter all that much.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Your underlings are absent...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps they are tied up with the beasts running amok.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: About that, please be sure to thank the Doctor for me.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Master!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: All taken care of. Some of our men are hurt, but nothing major.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I just got some news from Weiss—

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sharp? What are you doing here...?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I'm on a mission.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Doctor's orders? Did the Doctor anticipate this...?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: How did you know it was me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's not that hard at all.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I already told you. I'm very familiar with warriors who can break a deadlock.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enciodes!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Are you alright? Where's the assassin?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Arctosz, I never expected to see you here. Perhaps this is a portent of the Silverashes and Paleroches finally burying the hatchet?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Pfft! I'm here, but that's got nothing to do with you!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm only here to flush out the underhanded lowlife who dared to disrupt Kjeragandr's Grand Ceremony! They will pay for this!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You are truly Kjeragandr's most faithful follower, Arctosz.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm afraid you came too late, though.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What do you mean? You would never let an assassin go. Where are you hiding him?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Wait, this cliff... Don't tell me...!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Exactly, Arctosz. My men will look for any traces of her.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let's continue our hunt.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: There's blood on the ground. Are you hurt?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's nothing major.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Master, we must treat your wounds immediately!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: We must... We must at least stop the bleeding!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We're getting back to the hunt.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I refuse to ruin Kjeragandr's ceremony.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Send the word out that all is well.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Of course.
Before everyone's eyes, the young head of the Silverash clan takes a step forward.
The snow blows all around him, scattering as he gazes upward. There is not a single scripture that describes such a sight.
The patches of red behind him gradually turn fainter in color, before finally leaving nothing but pure white that blends into the mountainous scenery.
No one can stop him. No one dares to.
Enciodes keeps walking straight ahead.
